development.selection_rule: Minimum FP32 normalized HOMO/LUMO MAE on the 512 fixed development molecules across predefined Uni-Mol2 sizes; no test or generated-candidate scores used.

dataset.hydrogens: All explicit source hydrogens, no embedding or atom addition
dataset.locked_test: Original scaffold-held-out test, IDs and geometry frozen before fitting; labels not used for selection
dataset.generator_overlap_scope: Known SFT training identities only; pretraining corpus overlap unknown

scope: Common-support source 3D prediction. Historical DPA retained separately; common DPA and Uni-Mol share exact splits. Calibration intervals are empirical, not guaranteed conditional probabilities.

version_selection.selection_rule: Minimum FP32 normalized HOMO/LUMO MAE on the 512 fixed development molecules across predefined Uni-Mol2 sizes; no test or generated-candidate scores used.

input_contract.padding: group by canonical per-molecule padded length, matching train/inference

metadata.uncertainty: Single chosen checkpoint; use residual calibration, not zero spread as certainty
metadata.validation_precision: BF16 autocast; final evaluation also records FP32 precision sensitivity

input_contract.padding: group by canonical per-molecule padded length, matching train/inference

metadata.uncertainty: Single chosen checkpoint; use residual calibration, not zero spread as certainty
metadata.validation_precision: BF16 autocast; final evaluation also records FP32 precision sensitivity

source_test_history: Same test previously reported for v1; v2 selected exclusively on development.

input_verification.model_source: AST identical apart from import redirection
input_verification.scope: Input and model-source verification; does not claim bitwise parity with Uni-Core fused CUDA kernels.

geometry_diagnostic.scope: No new quantum labels; stability only

selection_diversity.scope: All frozen selection repetitions; equal targets then seeds. Unique fraction, scaffold count and fingerprint distance reported together. No B-based selection.

quantum_summary.scope: Fixed exploratory cohort, not population success estimation. Geometry failures remain in all 24 planned denominators. No candidate replacement or evaluator-based selection.
